title: Peppercorn · late summer
caption: Props stand in harvested clumps with pepper plants among them; near trees turn yellow, not green.

title: Art slot · spring on the marsh
caption: Reed beds, pools and wet sedge for the salt marsh; blossom thinned and given a dark step.

title: Ironvein · overcast
caption: Cut quarry stone in the wood; puddles fewer and lying in the ground, not floating.

title: Rosethread · misty morning
caption: Less haze over the pines, willows along the river forest, reeds at the fords, less dew speckle.

title: Scrolls slot · frost
caption: No green ring round the road, softer snow, green pines under snow, mushroom hollows in the wood.

title: Danger ground · wildfire
caption: The burn has a ragged rim, an ember edge and a rounder shape; the light square halo is gone.

title: Danger ground · lakes
caption: The water sits below the grass: a bank shadow, a deeper middle, and reeds at the rim.

title: Danger ground · cursed
caption: The blight now sits a little below the meadow. Its cracks and skulls are unchanged.

title: The road
caption: A sunken dirt lane with broken wheel tracks and a few pebbles.

title: The battle wagon
caption: Round spoked wheels, and a clearing in the wood to stand in.

title: The gate
caption: A standing palisade of sharpened stakes across the road, where the planks used to lie flat.

title: Slots and overlays
caption: Kept as they are: the lit grid, the cursed tiles, the star, clearance and rings.

title: Shots and hits
caption: Kept as they are: outlined shots in the hero’s ink, and a hit mark at the point of contact.
